extent.geography: global modeled agricultural heat-work burden and global agricultural workforce

transformations.formula: Convert source thousand-hours to hours and normalize the agricultural component only; do not add it to the all-sector total.
Normalize the ILO global agricultural workforce as exposed scope, not as a count of injured workers.
Normalize the number of complete annual Lancet global observations.
Assign full extent for the source global model and workforce assessment.

receipts.uncertainty: Lancet work-loss values are modeled from WBGT, employment and sector assumptions. WOAH production loss is a synthesized global estimate; outbreak reporting, surveillance, disease definitions and indirect economic losses vary.
receipts.freshness: Reviewed global agricultural-health assessment through 2024; snapshot captured 2026-08-01T15:38:03.648Z.

selection_reason.selected_method_passed: Lancet and ILO quantify current global agricultural heat-work loss, the exposed workforce, a 35-year annual series and global scope.
higher_priority_failures: The node contract does not have a globally observed worker-level threshold-exposure census, so the accumulated impact tier is used.

transformations.formula: Normalize the WOAH synthesized global share of animal production lost to disease.
Normalize annual farmer losses without adding outbreak-specific values.
Normalize the lower-bound HPAI outbreak count; retain poultry loss separately.
Divide countries and territories reporting HPAI outbreaks by 193 UN Member States as a conservative denominator.

Normalize current HPAI animal outbreaks as a zoonotic-pressure indicator, not as human outbreaks.
Divide current reporting countries and territories by 193 UN Member States.
